title: I-820 archive photos
text:
As of the late 2010s, the eastern side of Loop 820 was still mostly in its originally-built configuration dating back to its opening in September 1963. The only major improvement since its original construction was the interchange at I-30.

The first contract for phase 1 of expansion in the north section (along SH 121) was awarded in December 2017 for $174 million. In November 2021 TxDOT awarded a $1.6 billion contract for the Southeast Connector at I-20, which included I-820 from I-20 to Rosedale. In March 2023 the scope of the Southeast Connector was expanded to include the section from Rosedale to I-30, with the total project cost for the Southeast Connector increasing to $2.1 billion.

As of 2025, work on the northeast section (north of I-30) was complete or substantially complete. Work on the southeast section (south of I-30) is scheduled for completion in 2028.
